Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring photo identification in the sale and purchase of products containing ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and phenylpropanolamine.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring photo identification in the sale andpurchase of products containing ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, andphenylpropanolamine; and adding a new section to chapter 69.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A pharmacy licensed by, or shopkeeper or itinerant vendorregistered with, the department of health under chapter 18.64 RCW, oran employee thereof, or a practitioner as defined in RCW 18.64.011, maynot knowingly sell, transfer, or otherwise furnish to any person aproduct that he or she knows to contain ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, orphenylpropanolamine, their salts, isomers, or salts of isomers, withoutfirst obtaining photo identification of the person that shows the dateof birth of the person, and having the person sign a written log orreceipt showing the date of the transaction, name of the person, andthe amount of the product being sold, transferred, or otherwisefurnished. (2) A person buying or receiving a product containing ephedrine,pseudoephedrine, or phenylpropanolamine, their salts, isomers, or salts p. 1 HB 1018of isomers, from a pharmacy licensed by, or shopkeeper or itinerantvendor registered with, the department of health under chapter 18.64RCW, or an employee thereof, or a practitioner as defined in RCW18.64.011, must first produce photo identification of the person thatshows the date of birth of the person, and sign a written log orreceipt showing the date of the transaction, name of the person, andthe amount of the product being sold, transferred, or otherwisefurnished.
